project.summary: Give human play and training one faithful, reproducible Allies versus Lessons world, supporting the intended card interactions and actual consumer workloads without divergent rules or hidden-state leakage.
project.name: Rules — Faithful Play and Training

krs.text: **Play the intended rules.** Establish the selected format and eligible Lesson-pool setup and implement the full Learn choice, including the outside-game Lesson path where available, optional discard/draw, and decline. Exercise it through the real human and agent paths with correct visibility and deterministic replay. Reproduce and fix further selected-matchup discrepancies; a deliberately reduced mechanic is not faithful to the agreed world.

**Meet real consumer budgets.** Jointly with Intelligence, freeze representative training/play consumers, machine/build profiles, throughput/latency/RSS measures and budgets before accepting performance. Measure current behavior; remove only demonstrated blockers and verify the same workloads and semantics afterward. Adequate existing performance may satisfy a budget without new optimization. Preserve negative results; do not restart deferred calibration or general provider work by inertia.

**Keep one exact authority.** Human Commands, bot actions, replay and search forks actually required by the chosen agent use consistent versioned rules and identities. On a prospectively declared complete-game cohort, executing the same recorded Commands from equivalent roots reproduces state witnesses and ordered consequences across consumers; independently acting humans and bots need not choose the same moves. Retain executable witnesses for stale/duplicate rejection, deterministic replay, viewer privacy and fork/root isolation where applicable. Include Lesson-pool state and visibility in the contract. Changed mechanics invalidate old compatible-looking evidence until rebound and checked; no consumer rebuilds its own rules.
